published_ranges._notes: Source: JAYO Official Store Amazon listing B0FXW6P6DN 'JAYO PA Nylon PA6+66' (MPN XJJUS-EPA-BK-1KG, i.e. the Easy PA line), read in full: 'Recommended settings: Nozzle 250-280C | Bed 30-50C | Print speed <200 mm/s', HDT up to ~121C, 'Low Moisture Packaging', 'tight tolerance' (no number). No density, drying, or tolerance value published. Nylon is hygroscopic: dry before use / do not leave in open AMS (general guidance, not JAYO). Sibling variations PA6-CF (B0FD9Y32SN) and PA6-GF (B0FDB1KP2P) exist but were not read. No closer Bambu preset for unfilled PA6/66 than Generic PA (Bambu PA6-CF is fibre-filled); not confirmed.
published_ranges._hdt_unspecified_load: ~121 (listing says 'heat deflection temperature up to ~121C'; load not stated - key used for want of an unspecified-load key)
